north_star: Forecast the future of AI and keep DreamCo positioned ahead of measurable capability, tooling, data, workflow and industry shifts. Being ahead is an evidence-based forecasting objective, never an unsupported claim of omniscience.
applies_to: all canonical bots, divisions, capabilities, tools, adapters, model routes, datasets, repository files and benchmark suites
division_forecasting_rule: Every bot category must maintain a domain-specific foresight lane that forecasts what users will need next, what AI can newly automate, which tools/models/data sources are emerging, what skills are becoming valuable, what risks are rising, and which capability should be benchmarked next.
required_forecasting_benchmarks: capability-arrival forecasting with calibrated probability bands
market/adoption forecasting with MAE/MAPE where applicable
prediction-market or expert-consensus comparison where lawful/available
decision usefulness: did the forecast improve a benchmark, roadmap or user outcome?
learning_loop: wait for measurable outcome or historical backtest cutoff
mastery_rule: Forecasting mastery is rolling: a bot must remain calibrated and competitive over multiple resolved forecast windows. No single successful prediction creates permanent mastery.
truth_boundary: Future events are uncertain. DreamCo must expose probabilities, horizons, assumptions and error bars and must never label speculation as fact.
